items.title: Nine Soldiers Join Warrant Officer Ranks at Camp Atterbury Graduation
items.description:
CAMP ATTERBURY, Ind. — Nine soldiers celebrated their graduation from the Warrant Officer Candidate School on Saturday, Aug. 22, joining the ranks of the Army's premier technical experts during a ceremony at the Umbarger Conference Center.
 
The graduates of Class 26-002, who adopted the class motto "Long Time Running," completed a rigorous, multi-phased program designed to transition seasoned enlisted soldiers into trusted technical advisors and leaders.

items.title: Montana Army National Guard Chinook Crew Returns After Supporting Washington Wildfire Suppression

items.title: Navy Medicine demonstrates readiness during Billings Navy Week
items.description: U.S. Navy Rear Adm. Matthew Case, acting surgeon general of the Navy and acting chief, U.S. Navy Bureau of Medicine and Surgery, joined more than 80 Sailors in Billings, Montana, to kick off the city’s first-ever Navy Week, Aug. 20-22. The 3-day visit was part of a Navy Office of Community Outreach (NAVCO) program that brings senior U.S. Navy leaders together with the local community to increase awareness and understanding of the Navy’s mission and heritage.
items.unit_name: U.S. Navy Bureau of Medicine and Surgery
